header: Supported versions of Elasticsearch and OpenSearch
content:
OpenSearch Service supports the following versions of OpenSearch:
• 3.1, 2.19, 2.17, 2.15, 2.13, 2.11, 2.9, 2.7, 2.5, 2.3, 1.3, 1.2, 1.1, and 1.0
OpenSearch Service supports the following versions of legacy Elasticsearch:
• 7.10, 7.9, 7.8, 7.7, 7.4, 7.1, 6.8, 6.7, 6.5, 6.4, 6.3, 6.2, 6.0, 5.6, 5.5, 5.3, 5.1, 2.3, and 1.5
We recommend upgrading to the latest available OpenSearch version to get the best use of
OpenSearch Service, in terms of price-performance, feature richness, and security improvements.
